name: gnomAD v4.1 (exomes and genomes) allele frequencies

version.value: v4.1 (4.1.2 for constraint); site shows v4.1.2, v3.1.2, v2.1.1

scope: 730,947 exomes and 76,215 genomes mapped to GRCh38 (v4); site-level allele counts per ancestry group.
mapping_methods: Coordinates on GRCh38 (v4, v3) or GRCh37 (v2.1.1 with liftover files).

quantitative.summary: Allele counts, numbers and frequencies; filtering annotations.
quantitative.uncertainty: AC/AN; no CI provided in sites VCF

licence.name: Primary exome/genome data released under CC0; some annotations carry separate terms (SpliceAI is CC BY-NC 4.0)
licence.redistribution: CC0 for primary data; honour separate annotation terms

update_frequency: Major releases every few years; point releases (4.1.1, 4.1.2) in between.
coverage_limitations: Per-chromosome VCFs are very large (e.g. exome chr1 17.56 GiB, genome chr1 41.25 GiB)
Not a random sample of any population
known_omissions: Allele-frequency filtering bias against disease cohorts is noted by the consortium

reuse_decision.rationale: Chromosome-scale files are hundreds of GiB. Do not mirror; use the Ensembl VEP gnomAD/frequency plugins, dbNSFP frequency fields or on-demand tabix/API queries, and acquire regional slices when a target analysis needs them.

status.notes: Downloads page rendered; S3 listing reachable.
